architecture.summary: S2.5-R1 adds OrganizationMemberFacts and memberFactsPage to the existing OrganizationDirectory public module and moves only the removal safety scan to that facts-only operation. The WorkOS adapter retains membership, role-catalog, raw management, grant, revision, scope, cursor and stop rules without per-member user enrichment. The direct target member() read and Members display/seat pages keep their email reads. Current authority, complete pagination, target agreement, last-Admin checks, exact deletion, durable admission and matching receipts keep their rules. The existing ten-page scan limit, 30-second lifetime, five-second WorkOS timeout and no-retry settings remain. This changes an interface and sensitive removal collaboration between existing Organizations and WorkOS components in the hosted Node server. Registry prose records facts versus display; all Mermaid views remain accurate and unchanged. No component, dependency edge, public module membership, client or cross-container contract, external integration, deployment, schema, recovery, notice selection or policy changes against the actual S2.5-02 parent. Controlled latency evidence is a regression case, not a capacity guarantee. Independent current-candidate architect approval, complete-candidate checks and the separate S2.5-02 release/owner gates remain required.
